stage: PRE-REGISTERED harness validation / falsification test: does softmax attention acquire MQAR under THIS harness on an easy panel with a generous budget, as Zoology reports it does?
why_this_matters: This is the experiment most likely to overturn the programme's headline claim, and the preprint itself names it as the first thing a skeptical reader should ask for. It is run BEFORE publication, not after, and its result will be reported whichever way it falls.
primary_endpoint: transition_count (recall > 0.8), paired by seed; primary statistic McNemar exact

preregistered_predictions.expected: Attention CROSSES on the easy panel at 3e15 (>=4 of 8 seeds). This is the outcome that VALIDATES the harness and confirms the paper's protocol explanation: attention can acquire MQAR here, and its failure on the hard panels is a budget/difficulty effect rather than an incapacity.
preregistered_predictions.falsifying: Attention crosses in 0 of 8 at 3e15 AND at every escalation below, i.e. it never acquires MQAR under this harness even on an easy panel at ~33x the budget the candidate needs on a HARDER panel. That would mean the harness differs materially from the reference literature in a way this programme has not identified, and the transformer claim MUST NOT be published until the discrepancy is explained. This is a stop condition, not a limitation to be noted.
preregistered_predictions.candidate_control: The candidate arm must cross in most seeds on this easy panel; if it does not, the panel or the configuration is broken and the run is INCONCLUSIVE for both arms.

preregistered_escalation_ladder: Stage 1 (this launch): 3e15, 8 paired seeds. If the transformer crosses in >=1 seed, the harness is validated and the campaign stops -- no escalation. If it crosses in 0 of 8, Stage 2 runs 3e16 (10x) on 6 seeds. If that is also 0/6, Stage 3 runs 1e17 on 3 seeds. Only after Stage 3 returns 0/3 is the falsifying outcome declared. Escalation thresholds are fixed here, before any result is seen, so that a null cannot be rescued by unbounded budget-hunting.
cost: zero cloud spend; local V100s. Stage 1 ~8.5 min/run, 4 runs per shard, ~35 min wall.
